description: Language-neutral Eidos Runtime 1.0 conformance suite executed identically against JS and Rust runtimes.

cases.description: Negotiates protocol eidos-runtime 1.0 with capabilities and limits
Creates a file, inspects snapshot and paginated schema
Creates table with multiple field types, inserts/queries/updates/deletes rows, verifies revision conflict and undo
Previews formula evaluation and converts numeric text column to number
Tests forward relation, inverse relation, resolveRelations labels, and Lookup aggregates (values, count, sum, distinctValues)
Tests TODAY() timezone resolution, calendar-period, and calendar-window filters identically across JS and Rust
A record and its neighbors remain addressable across the 1000-row page limit.
Tests queryGroupRows cursor paging, getRowsById (with missingRowIds), getRecordNeighbors, and getRowIndex
Tests set-field-nullable, set-field-position, set-table-position, set-record-label, and rename-option (reject and merge)
